name: Battery Usage
author: OverStyleFR
description: Live battery draw (watts) with a consumption graph, stats, runtime estimate and an optional web dashboard.

barWidget.description: Instant wattage readout that opens a panel with a live consumption graph, averages, energy and battery details.

schema.label: AC sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the battery draw is sampled while on AC power.

schema.label: Battery sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the battery draw is sampled on battery with the balanced power profile.

schema.label: Power-saver sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the battery draw is sampled on battery with the power-saver profile.

schema.label: Performance sampling interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the battery draw is sampled on battery with the performance profile.

schema.label: Graph window (minutes)
schema.description: Time span rendered in the consumption graph.

schema.label: Power profile refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the active power profile is re-read to adjust the sampling cadence.

schema.label: Panel refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often battery details are refreshed while the panel is open.
